style_preset: Cinematic Vedic High-Fantasy / Classical Indian Fine Art

characters.name: Krishna
characters.nature: Omniscient, serene, cosmic wisdom, divine grace, playful yet authoritative counselor

Dark sapphire skin, enchanting compassionate eyes, golden crown with a luminous peacock feather, wearing silk yellow pitambara robes. Divine radiant aura, serene enigmatic smile, holding reins of white horses with glowing cosmic dust in the background.
